article.headline: Queens beats West Georgia 91-84
article.description: — Nasir Mann had 26 points and 10 rebounds as Queens beat West Georgia 91-84 on Saturday.

categories.description: West Georgia Wolves @ Queens University Royals

event.description: West Georgia Wolves @ Queens University Royals

keywords: West Georgia Wolves @ Queens University Royals
article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C -- — Nasir Mann had 26 points and 10 rebounds as Queens beat West Georgia 91-84 on Saturday. Yoav Berman scored 15 points and added five rebounds for the Royals (17-12, 12-4 Atlantic Sun Conference). Avantae Parker, who shot 5 of 7 from the field and 5 for 9 from the foul line, also scored 15 points. Josh Smith led the Wolves (12-16, 6-10) with 20 points. Kenneth Chime added 14 points, 11 rebounds and two steals for West Georgia. Shelton Williams-Dryden also had 14 points, six rebounds and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
